{{Quote|Credentials please.|Jat'ho, to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Invincible" />}}
'''Jat'ho''' was an [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]]. He served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] along with his partner, [[Tobyl]]. In [[41 ABY]], they were part of an [[Skirmish on Coruscant (Second Galactic Civil War)|operation]] to capture [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Er, I mean, we never saw you. Right Jat'ho?|Tobyl, to Jaina Solo and Jat'ho|<ref name="Invincible" />}}
[[File:JainaSolo_EssentialAtlas.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jat'ho was mind tricked by Jaina Solo (pictured).]]
Jat'ho was an older [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]]<ref name="Invincible" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] serving in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Invincible" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> Jat'ho and his partner, [[Tobyl]], were part of an [[Skirmish on Coruscant (Second Galactic Civil War)|operation]] to capture [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. After the fight, the two [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were conducting crowd control and guarding a [[Medical speeder|medwagon]] with two wounded GAG [[Agent/Legends|agents]] when they were approached by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="Invincible" />

Needing the medwagon to pursue the GAG [[doomsled]] carrying Skywalker, Jaina told Jat'ho and his partner she was investigating their [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Qade]], and needed the medwagon to conduct her investigation. She also insisted that no report be written; when Tobyl was initially hesitant, Solo utilized a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince the police of her story. Believing her, they let her pass, and she took the medwagon. Jat'ho and Tobyl, meanwhile, returned to their crowd control duties.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm undercover. I have no credentials.''"<br />"''She's undercover. She has no credentials.|Jaina Solo, using a mind trick on Jat'ho|<ref name="Invincible" />}}
Jat'ho had [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] surrounded by deep cracks. His hands had long [[Claw/Legends|talons]]. Noticing that both Jat'ho and his partner were weak-minded, Jaina Solo was easily able to use mind tricks on both to convince them she was part of the Galactic Alliance Guard. Believing her story, Jat'ho stayed back, allowing Tobyl to do the talking.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jat'ho appeared in the novel [[Legacy of the Force: Invincible|''Invincible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]]<ref name="Invincible" /> and released on [[May 13]], [[2008]]<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/news20080428.html|text=Del Rey Offers Free Download of First Book in Legacy of the Force Series}}</ref> as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Invincible" /> The entry for Jat'ho in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which was published on [[December 9]], [[2008]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> incorrectly lists Jat'ho as a member of the Galactic Alliance Guard instead of the Coruscant Security Force.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
